title: Sim City 4 Music Replacement
description: Replaces all the ambient music with the entire OST of Sim City 4.
body: Tired of Lena Raines and C4eightaines? Enter the wonderful world of Sim City (four) with music of past and present enjoyment. Build a building and hear it too!! Replaces all the ambient music with the entire OST of Sim City 4. Does not mess with music disks in any way. Different tracks play during survival, main menu, nether, etc.
